why: Серия «Балкон до и после», формула преображения балкона «было обычно — стало уютно» (11,5 млн просмотров) и ваш ролик «балкон + пергола» (47 тыс.). Цель — охват владельцев небольших балконов и заявки на замер.
rules: Roman Group (ArtVitrage) works ONLY with glass. Main product (about 2 of 3 videos): frameless glazing of balconies and verandas (windows for balconies), pergolas, balcony blinds. Also: stained glass, decorative mirrors, glass kitchen backsplashes (skinali), glass partitions. EVERY shot must clearly show glass work as the main subject. Forbidden shots: kitchens or rooms where cabinets, appliances or furniture are the subject and no glass is clearly visible in focus; furniture or cabinets being built or assembled; woodwork; drinking glasses, glassware, bottles or jars; tiles, plaster or other trades; mosques, churches and religious images (synagogue stained glass only from his own photos). Never mention furniture. No prices, no deadlines, no client names, no other companies' objects.

problems: Frames 2 and 3 (1.9s and 3.2s) are near-identical: the same woman in a pink robe on a balcony, so the video feels static
The woman with a cup is generic lifestyle footage; the glass is barely visible and is not the subject
In frame 2 the caption 'комната' sits over the woman's body and the shot shows a railing and an open balcony, not glazing, so it contradicts the voice about a room appearing
In frame 4 (4.5s) the person is cropped from behind and the shot is dim with an overexposed window, so the glass is not clearly shown
Frames 6 and 7 (7.1s and 8.4s) are near-identical: the same building facade with a distant balcony, with no close-up of the glazing
qa.fix: Replace the repeated woman-in-robe and facade shots with varied close-ups of Roman Group's own frameless glazing, such as sliding glass panels being opened and a before/after of an open balcony becoming a glazed room, and keep the captions off the people and the foliage.
